payload.description: Housing performance figures in a form anyone can check. The council's quarterly report carries a target, an intervention level and an actual for each housing indicator. The numbers themselves are screenshots of a dashboard pasted into a PDF, so they cannot be searched or checked by machine. Everything on this page taken from them was read off the images by eye and is flagged for human checking.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 8 September 2026
